//: Records the loader's verdict on each test package when that package is opened alone in
Load mode with the wolf plugins, the stub plugins and the package directories that the
tests use. Every directory under packages/ is listed exactly once.
test_LinguistLoad opens each package and checks the verdict recorded here; this file
therefore records the observed behavior of the loader rather than an expectation.
scripts/test_check_declarations.py reads the same file and requires the lint to reject
every package under refused, linting each package together with the packages listed
under lintWith, which are the targets of its refs. A package that the loader rejects for a reason
the lint cannot detect from the declarations is listed under refusedByTheLoaderOnly,
A package listed with requires is checked only in a build that includes that plugin.

refusedByTheLoaderOnly.compat-consumer-too-new: Rejected because no installed package satisfies its dependency. The lint rejects it only if compat-provider is linted together with it; the lint tests cover that case separately.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.lang-model: Depends on wolf/g2p-multi, a converted package that is not among the test packages.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.multi-scheme: A DataOnly fixture whose import targets are deliberately absent; only a full load detects the missing targets.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.pinyin-rollback: Its chain configuration contains an unknown key. The lint validates exports and import options but not the configuration of each variant.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.singer-model: Depends on a package that depends on wolf/g2p-multi, which is not among the test packages.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.singer-none: A DataOnly fixture whose import targets are deliberately absent; only a full load detects the missing targets.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.singer-ok: A DataOnly fixture whose import targets are deliberately absent; only a full load detects the missing targets.
refusedByTheLoaderOnly.unknown-field: A DataOnly fixture whose import targets are deliberately absent; only a full load detects the missing targets.
